decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm’s existing radiant-heating know-how, and with strong in-house R&D the firm is likely to improve and absorb learning from a component innovation rather than withdraw it quickly.
As an electric infrared product within the firm’s established heating domain, it is close enough to existing capabilities that management would expect to refine it and keep it in the portfolio.
Although somewhat more niche than other launches, it still rests on familiar infrared-heating knowledge and the firm’s R&D base supports continued learning instead of early exit.
This product is very close to the core business of heating large non-residential spaces, so the firm’s absorptive capacity and service network make continued commercialization highly likely.
It fits the firm’s strategic move toward lower-carbon and hydrogen-ready systems, and its strong related knowledge plus active R&D make management especially likely to persist with it.
